app.name: GachAnime
app.tagline: Open boosters, collect your favorite anime characters, trade with friends.

auth.required: Sign in with Discord to play.

collect.title: Collect
collect.body: A free booster every few minutes, five cards each, from common to mythic.

trade.title: Trade
trade.body: Swap cards with your friends or sell your duplicates on the market.

wiki.title: Discover
wiki.body: Every new card unlocks its character page in the wiki.

admin.title: Admin
admin.forbidden: This area is reserved for administrators.

dashboard.title: Catalog overview
dashboard.rarityHelp: Default rarities come from AniList favourites. Characters set by hand keep their rarity on re-import.
dashboard.emptyCatalog: The catalog is empty. Start with an AniList import.

series.title: Series
series.mergeHelp: Every other selected series is merged into the one you keep, then deleted.
series.deleteBody: Its media and memberships are deleted. Characters are kept. An AniList series comes back with the next import that reaches it: deactivate it instead to hide it for good.

seriesDetail.splitHelp: Select the media that form another series.
seriesDetail.splitConfirm: Move {count} media to a new series?

seriesForm.title: New manual series
seriesForm.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Used in URLs and roster imports.

roster.title: Import a JSON roster
roster.help: Creates or updates a manual series and its characters. Characters are matched by their key: importing the same file again updates them.
roster.invalidRoster: The roster does not match the expected format.

imports.title: Catalog import
imports.filtersHelp: Restricts the import to the most popular anime having one of the chosen genres and one of the chosen tags. Shōjo, shōnen or seinen are tags (Demographic), not genres.

rateNotes.anilist: AniList currently allows about 30 requests per minute: importing the top 500 with their franchises takes a few hours. An interrupted import resumes where it stopped.
rateNotes.igdb: IGDB allows 4 requests per second: importing the 200 most rated games takes a few minutes. Games are grouped by IGDB series; only characters with a portrait are imported, and their rarity comes from the popularity of their most popular game.

settings.title: Game settings
settings.dailyResetHelp: When daily missions and market limits start over.
settings.zeroUnlimited: 0 means unlimited. Days follow the daily reset.
settings.offerTtlDays: Offer lifetime in days (0 = never expires)
settings.imageCacheHelp: The worker downloads catalog pictures (AniList) to this server so that players never load them from AniList. Count about 15 KB per character on disk. Disabling stops new downloads; cached files stay in use.
settings.adultImportsHelp: By default, imports skip anime flagged as adult on AniList and games with the Erotic theme on IGDB. These flags have false positives (popular games, ecchi series). Applies to the next imports and to the AniList search.
settings.wishlistHelp: Chance that a drawn card is one of the player's wished characters of its rarity, if they do not own it and it is in the booster's pool. Rarity rates do not change.
settings.recycleHelp: Every rarity recycle value (Admin → Rarities) is multiplied by this rate, then by the player's recycling upgrade. Gems per copy are rounded.

upgrades.noLevel: No level: players cannot buy this upgrade.

boosterStorage.title: Upgrade: booster storage
boosterStorage.help: Free boosters a player can store on top of the maximum above. Each level gives its own value (not added to the previous ones); values must increase.

boosterSpeed.title: Upgrade: faster boosters
boosterSpeed.help: Shortens the time between free boosters by this percentage. Each level gives its own value; values must increase.

recycleBonus.title: Upgrade: recycling bonus
recycleBonus.help: Multiplies the gems of recycled duplicates (on top of the base multiplier). Each level gives its own value; values must increase.

rarities.title: Rarities
rarities.help: Names, default rarity thresholds (AniList favourites for anime, IGDB ratings of the most popular game for video games), recycling values and market price bounds.
rarities.thresholdHelp: Thresholds must increase with the rarity. Changing one re-applies the default rarity of every imported character (AniList and IGDB), except those set by hand.

boosters.title: Booster tiers
boosters.help: Per-card rates in parts per million (they must sum to 1,000,000) and prices in gems.

missions.title: Missions
missions.help: A mission counts one game event per period. Deactivate a mission rather than deleting it.
missions.filterHelp: One field=value per line, e.g. tier=divine.
missions.filterInvalid: Each filter line must look like field=value.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.help: An achievement measures a metric against a target.
achievements.stickyHelp: Players who already completed the achievement keep it, even if you raise the target.

themes.reorderHelp: Drag the packs (or use the arrows) to set their order in the shop, then save.
themes.title: Packs
themes.help: A pack is a free booster that draws only the characters matching its rules (premium boosters always draw from the whole catalog). Its content is updated when you save it and after every catalog change.
themes.emptyRarities: No character for: {rarities}. These draws fall back to the next lower rarity, then the next higher one.
themes.deleteBody: Past openings keep their cards. To hide a pack for a while, deactivate it instead.

rules.title: Rules
rules.help: Series rules (tag, genre, format, type, series) match a character when one of its series matches.

users.title: Users
users.banBody: They are signed out and can no longer sign in. Their cards and listings are kept.

boosters.title: Boosters
boosters.subtitle: Every booster holds five cards. Free boosters recharge over time.
boosters.noTier: No booster is available right now.
boosters.full: Your free boosters are full: open some!
boosters.tapToOpen: Tap the booster to open it
boosters.paidSubtitle: Spend your gems for better odds. Gems come from recycling duplicates, missions and achievements.

packs.title: Free boosters
packs.help: Open the whole catalog, or a category or character type: every booster here costs one free charge.

collection.title: My collection
collection.empty: No card yet. Open your first booster!
collection.seriesSubtitle: Complete a series by owning all of its characters.

wiki.title: Wiki
wiki.subtitle: Every card you obtain unlocks its character entry.
wiki.lockedBody: Obtain this character in a booster to unlock the entry.
wiki.owned: You own {count} copy | You own {count} copies
wiki.notOwned: You no longer own this card (the entry stays unlocked)

wishlist.title: My wishlist
wishlist.boostHelp: Each card you draw has a {percent} chance to be one of your wished characters of its rarity, in every booster and pack that contains them. Characters you already own are not boosted.
wishlist.full: Your wishlist is full: remove a character to add another one.
wishlist.empty: Your wishlist is empty. Add characters with the heart on their card, in the collection or the wiki.

recycle.title: Recycle duplicates
recycle.description: Turn the copies you do not need into gems. Your first copy of each character and copies locked in trades or on the market are always kept.
recycle.nothing: No duplicate to recycle with these rarities.
recycle.total: {cards} card from {characters} characters → {gems} gems | {cards} cards from {characters} characters → {gems} gems
recycle.keepsFirst: One copy of each character is kept.
recycle.done: {cards} card recycled: +{gems} gems. | {cards} cards recycled: +{gems} gems.
recycle.singleHelp: {count} duplicate can be recycled, {gems} gems. | {count} duplicates can be recycled, {gems} gems each.
recycle.includeFavorites: Also recycle the duplicates of my favorites

gems.title: Gems
gems.subtitle: Every gem you earn or spend.

missions.title: Missions
missions.subtitle: Daily missions reset every day. Claim your rewards before they pile up!

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.subtitle: Long-term goals with gem rewards. Once completed, an achievement stays completed.

profile.wishlistHelp: Characters this player is looking for: offer them in a trade.
profile.noWishlist: This player has no character in their wishlist.
profile.emptyShowcase: Your first favorites appear here, in your order. The first one is your main favorite, shown next to your name.

trades.title: Trades
trades.subtitle: Swap cards with other players. The cards you offer are reserved until the trade ends.
trades.pickPlayer: Choose a player from their profile to start a trade.
trades.pickOffer: Pick the cards you give below.
trades.pickRequest: Pick the cards you want below.
trades.lastCopyWarning: You are giving your last copy of: {names}. The wiki entry stays unlocked.

empty.incoming: No offer waiting for your answer.

market.title: Market
market.subtitle: Buy cards from other players with gems, or sell yours. No fee: the seller gets the full price.

empty.active: You have no card on sale.

market.howToSell: Sell a card from its wiki entry.
market.allLocked: All your copies are already on sale or in a trade.
market.lastCopyWarning: This is your last copy. The wiki entry stays unlocked if it sells.
market.lastFavoriteWarning: This is your last copy of a favorite. The wiki entry stays unlocked if it sells, and it stays in your favorites.

errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.CONFLICT: This action conflicts with the current state. Please retry.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS: This action is already in progress.
errors.ANILIST_UNAVAILABLE: AniList is not reachable right now. Please retry later.
errors.INVALID_IMAGE: This image cannot be used (PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, 8 MB max).
errors.NOT_MANUAL_ENTRY: Only manually created series and characters can be edited this way.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side.
errors.NOT_ENOUGH_CHARGES: Not enough free boosters. Wait for the next one!
errors.EMPTY_POOL: There is no character to draw yet. An admin must import the catalog first.
errors.PREVIEW_OUTDATED: Your duplicates changed in the meantime. Check the new preview and confirm again.
errors.THEME_UNAVAILABLE: This pack is not available with this booster.
errors.CARD_UNAVAILABLE: This card is no longer available (locked, traded or sold).
errors.LISTING_UNAVAILABLE: This listing is no longer for sale.
errors.MARKET_LIMIT_REACHED: A market limit is reached. Try again tomorrow.
errors.PRICE_OUT_OF_RANGE: This price is outside the allowed range for this rarity.
errors.TRADE_NOT_PENDING: This offer is no longer pending.
errors.IGDB_UNAVAILABLE: IGDB is not reachable right now. Please retry later.
errors.IGDB_NOT_CONFIGURED: IGDB is not configured on this instance: set IGDB_CLIENT_ID and IGDB_CLIENT_SECRET (see the self-hosting guide).
errors.FAVORITES_FULL: You already have the maximum of {max} favorites.
errors.UPGRADE_UNAVAILABLE: This upgrade is already at its maximum level.
errors.UPGRADE_LEVEL_CHANGED: This upgrade changed in the meantime: check its new level.

favorites.title: My favorites
favorites.arrangeHelp: Pick up a card and drop it where you want it (mouse or finger), or use the arrows, then save.
favorites.empty: No favorite yet. Add the characters you prefer with the star on their card.
favorites.mainHint: The first favorite is your main favorite, shown next to your name.

upgrades.title: Upgrades
upgrades.subtitle: Spend gems on permanent bonuses for your account.

help.booster_storage: Store more free boosters before the timer stops.
